title: phlox stansburyi var. viscida
intro: Phlox stansburyi var. viscida, commonly known as the Utah phlox or sand phlox, is a plant species native to the western United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlox stansburyi var. viscida include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
